turns.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, $20 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Quincy 9-inch Antique Ocean Desk Globe. What caught your eye?

I need to interrupt. I've had two conversations with you. And you have stopped them five minutes in. I've answered all your questions, and you told me I'm gonna get a code, and I never get a code. I end the conversation myself. That's two times so far I've done this. So I don't think this is legitimate.

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry. I can't see your earlier calls, and I can't issue or check codes myself, so I can't promise what will show up.

Please email (email hidden) and tell them what happened on both calls, so a person can look into it. Would you like to carry on talking, or stop here?
